Why Sharjah, and why now

In May 2026 the Sharjah Executive Council formed a committee to implement the national policy for preserving modern architectural heritage, under the supervision of Sharjah Art Foundation. It held its first meeting on 10 September at the Flying Saucer.

This role turns that policy into fieldwork: survey drawings, archives, ownership records and adaptive reuse. My career so far has been about one thing, making sure the record is accurate. I want to apply it to buildings worth keeping.
